globalRules: De-duplicate audit rows by (BM, placeholder). Most rows appear twice because the audit emits both CONTRACT_SLOT_WITHOUT_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER and BINDING_WITHOUT_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER for the same field.
Do not blindly insert near generic anchors such as ..., (none), or misleading anchors like date lines. Open the source template and place the placeholder at the official numbered blank.
If a compound line already renders the value, do not add the atomic child field as another visible placeholder.

If the template already contains a suffixed variant such as document.fullDocumentCode4, document.fullDocumentCode6, or document.fullDocumentCode8, prefer canonical alias/rename/refactor over rendering duplicate placeholders.
After edits: run structure extraction, normalization, locked verification, and visual render QA.
